items.heading: Belgrave Harriers.
items.summary: Covering letter on Belgrave Harriers notepaper sent with the first Club Gazette, explaining its 6d. cost and asking members for a remittance if they wish to continue subscribing.
items.text:
Belgrave Harriers.

2, SUTHERLAND PLACE,
S.W. 1.

April, 1925.

Dear Sir,

I am pleased to enclose a copy of the Club Gazette, which is hoped will become a regular publication.

The cost of this is admittedly heavy, 6d. per copy, but it is only by every members support that the actual cost be defrayed.

Will you kindly endeavour to assist by forwarding a remittance and advising me of your wish to continue to subscribe.

Thanking you in hopeful anticipation.

Yours faithfully,

W. H. HARE.

people.name: W. H. Hare
people.note: signed the covering letter sent with the first Club Gazette
